# b402 Developer Documentation

> b402 puts the position on chain — not the wallet. Open-source infrastructure for agent payments and confidential DeFi. Live on Solana, Base, and BNB mainnet. Apache 2.0. Three stacks under one roof: Solana shielded pool with composable adapters (Jupiter, Kamino, Percolator), EVM HTTP-402 / x402 agent payments via the Facilitator, and ERC-7579 Nexus smart wallets with a Railgun-fork privacy pool on Base.

## Home
- [Introduction](https://docs.b402.ai/introduction): The pitch, install command, code examples for both stacks, what's live where
